title: **📸 American Drone Given a "Donkey Ride" in Asaluyeh**
text:
**📸 American Drone Given a "Donkey Ride" in Asaluyeh**"

"- The American MQ-9 drone, which was shot down by air defense forces in the mountains of Asaluyeh early Friday morning, was transported down the mountain with the help of a donkey."

"- Images released from the area show that the wreckage of the $30 million drone was broken down into smaller pieces and carried down through the rugged, difficult mountain paths using a donkey.
